column1: # gate-coverage-allowlist.tsv — the tracked paths that owe no step of the gate, each with the reason it does not.
# Read by `tools/check-gate-coverage.sh` (issue #943), which refuses every tracked path that no glob of the profile
# names unless a line here explains it. The format is one entry per line, `<pattern><TAB><reason>`: the pattern is a
# shell `case` glob over a repository-relative path, and the reason is what a reader of the profile needs in order to
# know why no step is owed. A line with no reason is refused, and so is a line with no pattern.
# A class entry (`vcpkg-overlays/**`) is written only where the whole class is deliberately ungated — a path added under
# it is ungated for the same reason the class is. Everywhere else an entry names one path, because the finding this
# check exists to print is the *new* file that nothing runs.
# This file is itself a tracked path: the profile's suite map names it, so a delta here owes the check.

column2: reason
third-party port overlays and triplets: consumed by the native build through vcpkg, and no suite of the gate reads them — a delta here is measured by the native build on a device
the wrapper's jar and its properties: the Gradle launcher, started by every build and read by no case
the daemon JVM criteria: read by Gradle at configuration, asserted by no suite of the gate
the build's own settings: read by Gradle at configuration, asserted by no suite of the gate
the build's launcher script
the build's launcher script on Windows
verbatim licence texts, the native licence map and the licence policy: the release's legal input, read by no suite of the gate
the project's licence text
repository plumbing: no suite reads it
the submodule pin's declaration: read by the build, and the compiled step owns a submodule whose sources change
the forge's review routing: read by the forge, not by a suite of the gate
the local properties a developer copies by hand: no suite reads it
a hand-run setup script: the gate's steps measure the tree, not the environment a person sets up
a hand-run vcpkg setup script: the native build's prerequisite, run by a person
a hand-run backlog pass over item documents: the issue tooling suite covers `tools/issues`, not this script
the structure suite's ratchet baseline, whose suite is `openspec/changes/package-structure-rules-and-suite` and is not landed yet — this entry is the line that has to move when it does
the skills' own scripts: run by the model that reads the skill, asserted by no suite of the gate
one-off probe scripts run by hand; they measure a model, not the tree
a hand-run spec sync: it writes the capability specs and no suite of the gate reads it
